description: This class, FormRenderer, is part of the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles rendering various types of forms (single, list, multi, upload) defined by the ModelForm model. It includes methods for rendering header rows, item rows, and handling hidden/ignored fields, and interacts with a FormStringRenderer to output form HTML or other formats. The class manages form fields, field groups, pagination, and dynamic form content generation, making it a central component for form rendering within OFBiz's widget framework.

classes.name: FormRenderer
classes.description: A form rendering engine within the OFBiz widget framework responsible for rendering forms based on ModelForm specifications. Handles different form types, header and item row rendering, hidden and ignored fields management, pagination, and interaction with a rendering interface for output generation.

methods.name: getCurrentContainerId
methods.description: Generates a unique container ID for the form, considering item index and parent item index for list-type forms.

methods.name: getCurrentFormName
methods.description: Returns the current form name, appending item index if the form is a list-type.

methods.name: getFocusFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the field that should receive focus when the form is rendered.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render the form, delegating to specific rendering methods based on form type (single, list, multi, upload). Handles form actions, setup, and rendering sequence.

methods.name: renderListFormString
methods.description: Renders list or tabular type forms, including headers and item rows with pagination.

methods.name: renderMultiFormString
methods.description: Renders forms that support multiple items/entries, with pagination.

methods.name: renderSingleFormString
methods.description: Renders a single item form, managing field grouping and layout.

methods.name: renderHeaderRow
methods.description: Constructs and renders the header row of a form, including column titles and spanning logic.

methods.name: renderHiddenIgnoredFields
methods.description: Outputs hidden and ignored fields as part of the form, ensuring they are included in the HTML output.

methods.name: renderItemRow
methods.description: Renders a single row within list/multi forms, including fields, spacers, and form cells.

methods.name: renderItemRows
methods.description: Iterates over list items, rendering each item as a set of form rows with proper context and pagination.

methods.name: checkFormData
methods.description: Verifies if the current list has data to determine whether to render form rows.

methods.name: safeNext
methods.description: Safely retrieves the next element from an iterator, returns null if no more elements.
